server_root.description: The top of the directory tree under which the server's configuration, error, and log files are kept.

listen_port.description: The port Apache listens on. Can be just port number or IP:port.

user.description: The user account the httpd daemon runs as.

group.description: The group account the httpd daemon runs as.

server_admin.description: The email address where server problems should be reported.

document_root.description: The directory out of which Apache will serve documents.

document_root_parent.description: The parent directory of DocumentRoot that is relaxed for access.

directory_index.description: The file Apache will serve if a directory is requested.

log_level.description: Control the number of messages logged to the error_log.

default_charset.description: Specify a default charset for all content served.

enable_sendfile.description: Enable sendfile syscall. Can be 'on' or 'off'.
